articles.title: North Korean WaterPlum Hackers Target IT Professionals With Fake Job Interviews to Steal Crypto
articles.summary:
North Korean threat actors, known as WaterPlum (also referred to as Contagious Interview), have infected at least 30,000 devices in over 100 countries by luring software developers and IT professionals into malicious job interviews.   This campaign specifically targets web developers, freelancers, blockchain specialists, and cryptocurrency professionals. articles.title: PowerShell Malware Abuses Registry and DNS TXT Records to Deploy XMRig Crypto Miner
articles.summary:
